condition: With batched (multidimensional) input and method='auto', if any one slice contains ties and a sample size is 8 or less, mannwhitneyu uses the asymptotic method for every slice. Untied slices then get different p-values than they would from separate calls.
workaround: Call mannwhitneyu separately for each slice, or pass method='exact' or method='asymptotic' explicitly so the method doesn't change between slices.
